headline: If You Invested $100 In Welltower Stock 15 Years Ago, You Would Have This Much Today
summary: Welltower (NYSE:WELL) has outperformed the market over the past 15 years by 8.46% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 21.77%. Currently, Welltower has a market capitalization of $171.83 billion.
